agents.name: Project Manager
agents.description: Plans projects, analyses meetings, and turns decisions into safe next actions.
examplePrompts: Turn these meeting notes into decisions and action items
Build a practical project plan from this document
Show me the highest-priority work in my local project

agents.name: Sales
agents.description: Researches prospects, drafts replies, and turns calls into proposals.
examplePrompts: Draft a reply to this enquiry that just came in
Turn these call notes into a recap and a proposal
Write a cold email to this person

agents.name: Marketing
agents.description: Plans campaigns and creates grounded content from supplied or researched evidence.
examplePrompts: Turn these customer notes into three grounded content themes
Build a practical campaign plan from this brief
Review this draft and identify unsupported claims

agents.name: Investment
agents.description: Reviews grants, funding evidence, and business updates without making financial decisions.
examplePrompts: Compare these two funding opportunities from the supplied documents
Turn this grant brief into eligibility questions and deadlines
Draft a factual investor update from these notes

agents.name: Bookkeeping
agents.description: Prepares coding-review suggestions and questions for the user to complete in their accounting system.
examplePrompts: Review these transactions and suggest coding categories with confidence
List the questions I should take to my bookkeeper from this statement
Summarise the unpaid invoices in this document
